en.t: A wave of sadness came over me, and I stood there stunned.

units.source_text: 祖父的话声一天比一天低沉，有气无力，越发听不清楚了。

en.t: Grandfather's voice grew lower day by day, weak and lifeless, and became harder and harder to hear clearly.

units.source_text: 同样的事，他反复唠叨十几遍。

en.t: He would repeat the same thing over and over, more than ten times.
